name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: A scratched entry in Darkshire points the search for Stalvan Mistmantle toward Goldshire.

sections.title: A Clue in the Ledger
sections.body: Clerk Daltry finds another destination beneath Stalvan Mistmantle's earlier entry in Darkshire's town registry. The hurried note is partly scratched out, as if someone meant to hide the route or changed their mind. It points northwest, toward the Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: Crossing into Elwynn
sections.body: You leave Duskwood's shadowed groves for Goldshire's sunny roads, but Stalvan's trail reaches here too. The Lion's Pride Inn stands at Elwynn Forest's crossroads, where travelers, merchants, and soldiers gather. Innkeeper Farley runs the busy taproom and may know of an educated wanderer looking for a room.

faq.q: Why does the trail lead to Goldshire?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry found a second address beneath Stalvan's first entry in Darkshire's registry. Though partly scratched out, it points to the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
Clerk Daltry keeps records in Darkshire's town hall. He maintains the local registries and helps uncover old documents about past residents.

faq.q: Who do I speak to at the Lion's Pride Inn?
faq.answer: Speak with Innkeeper Farley, who runs the Lion's Pride Inn and keeps track of travelers and patrons passing through Goldshire.

faq.q: Why was the entry scratched out in the registry?
faq.answer: The registry entry is only partly erased. Someone may have hurriedly tried to hide Stalvan's route toward Elwynn Forest as he left Duskwood.

faq.q: Does this quest involve any combat?
faq.answer: No. You travel from Darkshire's Town Hall to the taproom in Goldshire and ask about Stalvan.

faq.q: What is the Lion's Pride Inn?
faq.answer: The Lion's Pride Inn is Goldshire's central gathering place in Elwynn Forest. Travelers use it as a resting point on the roads between Stormwind City, Westfall, and Duskwood.

angles.text: You retrace Stalvan's steps through the heart of the Kingdom of Stormwind, from Duskwood's haunted frontier to familiar Elwynn Forest.
You follow local histories and cold trails across the southern Alliance, traveling between frontier outposts like Darkshire and hamlets like Goldshire.
